overview_description.description:
Kait is a SaaS company that provides integration with social media channels.

It is an AI-powered conversational platform that connects people with brands and helps businesses with customer service, marketing, and sales.

The Kuwait, Al Kuwayt-located company was founded in 2017 by Hisham Alkhudairi, Ali Alnajdi, and Ahmad Altraiji.

about_short_description.short_description: Kait is a SaaS company that provides integration with social media channels and helps businesses with marketing and sales.

product.name: Kait FlowBot
product.description: An AI-powered chatbot platform that automates customer interactions, handles transactions, and manages orders across messaging channels.

product.name: WhatsApp Business Integration
product.description: A service that enables businesses to receive and send WhatsApp messages, manage orders, and send notifications via multiple devices.

product.name: Twitter Direct Messages Integration
product.description: A platform integration that enables businesses to manage customer interactions and marketing through Twitter Direct Messages.

product.name: Instagram Messenger API Integration
product.description: A service that enables brands to communicate with customers through Instagram messaging channels.

product.name: Google Business Messages Integration
product.description: A conversational channel that connects businesses with customers via Google Maps, Search, and websites for messaging interactions.

product.name: Inbox by Kait
product.description: A unified inbox platform that consolidates messages from multiple social media and messaging channels for team collaboration and client management.
